body._fillet: Radius on vertical edges of the body.

remote_slots_long._comment: Tall remote pockets cut from the top face (laid out first, leftmost).

remote_slots_short._comment: Short remote pockets cut from the top face (laid out after long slots).

remote_layout._comment: Layout for the combined remote slot group.
remote_layout._offset_x: X offset of the combined slot group center from body center.

pen_slots._comment: Circular holes cut from the top face, arranged in a 2x2 grid beside the short remote slots.
pen_slots._positions: Explicit (x, y) centers for each pen hole. Placed in the Y-gap beyond the short remote slots.

split._comment: Horizontal split for printability. Two halves joined by alignment pins.
split._z: Z height where the body splits into top and bottom halves.
split._pin_height: Total pin length — half embeds in each piece.
split._pin_clearance: Extra diameter added to holes for press fit.
split._pin_inset_x: How far pin centers are inset from X edges.
split._pin_inset_y: How far pin centers are inset from Y edges.

phone_slots._comment: Thin slots cut through the front face (+X side). Phones slide in long-wise.
phone_slots._width: Opening width on the side face (Y span).
phone_slots._gap_bottom: Height (Z) of the bottom phone slot.
phone_slots._gap_top: Height (Z) of the top phone slot.
phone_slots._interior_length: How far the phone slot extends into the body (X).
phone_slots._spacing: Vertical gap (Z) between stacked phone slots.
phone_slots._offset_z: Z position of the bottom of the lowest slot.
